Hi Brendon,

Yes, let's sort this out. If the miner is running and shows an IP but the page won't load, one of two things is happening. Either the miner has dropped off your network, or it's still online and only its web page has stopped responding. These checks will tell us which, and you can do them without restarting it.

First, type the address in by hand as http:// plus the IP shown on the miner's screen, for example http://192.168.1.50. Use http, not https, and the exact IP from the screen today, because it has changed before. Do this on a computer or phone on the same home network as the miner. Turn off any VPN and stay off the guest Wi-Fi, since either one will block the page even when the miner is fine.

Second, ping the miner. On Windows, open Command Prompt; on a Mac, open Terminal. Type ping followed by the IP and see whether you get replies.

Third, log in to your pool's dashboard and see whether the BS-2 worker is still sending shares right now.

Here's how to read the results. If the pool still shows shares, or the ping gets replies, the miner is still online and only its web page has hung, which points at the firmware. If the pool shows it offline and the ping gets no replies, it's losing its Wi-Fi connection. In that case, try moving it closer to the router and give it a fixed IP in your router settings.

For now, turning it off at the wall for about 10 seconds and back on is a safe way to get it back.

This is the third time in a few weeks it's dropped like this, and it's running 0.2.100, a beta build. That makes the firmware my main suspect. The usual fix is to go back to Bitfortun's own stock firmware for the BS-2. I've sent your case to JD, our hardware lead, with the details. He'll confirm the right stock firmware for the BS-2 and how to install it. The team will reply in this thread, usually within one business day. Please hold off on installing the overclock kit until the unit has been stable for a while.

When you reply, tell me what the ping and the pool dashboard showed, and attach a photo of the miner's screen. If you'd like an answer faster, JD is very active on our Discord at https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf. Mention @nullhashrate there.

Hal
